sessions.phase_label: Queens Collegiate and JHS 157 agreement corrections

requirements.title: Allocated Budget Reporting
requirements.definition: Populate each agreement's allocated-budget field with the applicable full site allocation, distinguishing it from the smaller subcontract amount and explaining the discrepancy when required.
requirements.boundary_note: Site-specific dollar figures are parameters of the same allocated-budget field rule; wage calculations, budget-category balancing, dates, and signatures are independently testable behaviors.

requirements.title: Session-Based Wage Calculation
requirements.definition: Prepare salary and wages support calculations from actual compensated sessions and applicable rates so the calculations reflect the real session total rather than mechanically multiplying every weekly schedule slot.
requirements.boundary_note: Session count, rate, and resulting wage total are attributes of one calculation mechanism; selection of non-personnel categories for any remaining balance is independently constrained.

requirements.title: Approved Budget-Line Balancing
requirements.definition: When personnel calculations do not equal the subcontract total, reconcile the remaining amount using only client-approved non-personnel budget lines, including travel and consumable supplies.
requirements.boundary_note: This governs which budget categories may absorb a remaining balance and can change independently of the session-based salary calculation.

requirements.title: Service Period Date Consistency
requirements.definition: Record the applicable start and end dates for each site consistently across the agreement's term and schedule sections.
requirements.boundary_note: Site-specific date ranges are parameters of one consistency rule; the number-of-weeks field is separately testable and remains a distinct Requirement.

requirements.title: Weeks Served Accuracy
requirements.definition: Record the correct number of weeks served on Annex B Page 2, including changing the FCC/FH and 154Q forms from 6.75 weeks to four weeks.
requirements.boundary_note: The weeks-served field has its own reported error and financial effect, so it is separate from entering consistent start and end dates.

requirements.title: Site Identifier Labeling
requirements.definition: Use the client-confirmed site identity on each final agreement, including treating FCC and FH as the same school and using 154Q as the displayed name rather than 201.
requirements.boundary_note: The site aliases and selected display name are attributes of one document-identification behavior; unavailable contract IDs are not included because no required values were established.

requirements.title: Subcontractor Signature Placement
requirements.definition: Ensure each applicable agreement is signed in the subcontractor signature section rather than the contractor section.
requirements.boundary_note: Signature presence and placement form one independently verifiable behavior; the exact site affected by the later misplaced signature is not identifiable from the supplied text.

unresolved_candidates.description: FCC/FH and 154Q contract IDs were unavailable, but the evidence does not establish whether the final forms must intentionally leave those fields blank or obtain values later.
The subcontractor-signature correction is clear, but the supplied messages do not identify which of the two revised site agreements contained the misplaced signature.
